title: Wrap tooltip text
description:
Long help text in a tooltip must wrap. Write the word wrap `TextWrapped` does, with widths counted in characters:

```cpp
std::vector<std::string> wrapText(const std::string& text, int width);
```

- Words are separated by spaces. Put as many words on a line as fit in `width` characters, with one space between words.
- A word longer than `width` goes on a line of its own, cut into pieces of `width` characters.
- A newline `\n` in the text always starts a new line (an empty line between two `\n` stays as an empty line).
- Several spaces in a row count as one. No line starts or ends with a space.
- `width` below 1 is treated as 1.

```
wrapText("Air resistance. 0 means none.", 12)
    == { "Air", "resistance.", "0 means", "none." }
```
hints: Handle one paragraph (text between newlines) at a time. Read its words with a string stream, which skips extra spaces for you.
